title: Representation Fidelity: Auditing Algorithmic Decisions about Humans Using Self-Descriptions
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical concept of 'representation fidelity' and algorithmic fairness in decision-making systems (specifically loan granting). While fairness is an ethical concept, the work benchmarks data alignment and auditing procedures (fidelity of self-descriptions to structured input features) rather than evaluating or benchmarking religion, theology, or specific moral/ethical systems.
